headline: ‘S.N.L.’ Season Premiere: Buckets of Rain, With Jalen Brunson Reigning
context: Brunson, captain of the N.B.A. champion New York Knicks, hosted a “Saturday Night Live” show that satirized President Trump’s recent visit to Mayor Zohran Mamdani.
